vision: Enable seamless migration of customer profile data from PostgreSQL to MongoDB to support flexible, country-specific schemas required for global expansion while ensuring zero downtime, data integrity, and backward-compatible APIs.
scope: Migrate ~2M customer records (150GB) from PostgreSQL to MongoDB using CDC for backfill. Implement dual-write mechanism for a 2-week transitional period. Ensure zero data loss, stable API responses, and read latency under 50ms. Boundaries include database migration, schema adaptation, and infrastructure configuration without altering business logic or UI elements.
success_criteria: 100% of customer records successfully migrated and validated for parity
API remains backward-compatible throughout migration with zero downtime

user_stories.title: Design MongoDB schema to accommodate country-specific fields for flexible international data storage
user_stories.i_want: to design a document-based MongoDB schema for customer profiles
user_stories.so_that: new country-specific fields can be added without schema migrations or release delays

acceptance_criteria.given: existing PostgreSQL schema with fixed columns
acceptance_criteria.then: each document structure supports country-specific subfields without affecting existing data

user_stories.title: Implement CDC-based backfill process from PostgreSQL to MongoDB for customer profile data
user_stories.i_want: to configure CDC to stream changes from PostgreSQL to MongoDB
user_stories.so_that: data remains synchronized during migration and no records are lost

acceptance_criteria.given: existing PostgreSQL tables and target MongoDB collections
acceptance_criteria.then: all changes are captured and reflected accurately with zero data loss

user_stories.title: Enable dual-write mechanism between PostgreSQL and MongoDB during the migration period
user_stories.i_want: to write customer profile updates to both PostgreSQL and MongoDB
user_stories.so_that: data consistency is maintained across systems during phased migration

acceptance_criteria.when: a write operation occurs during dual-write period
acceptance_criteria.then: both databases are updated successfully and logs confirm consistency

user_stories.title: Validate record parity between PostgreSQL and MongoDB before final cutover
user_stories.i_want: to perform a data validation check ensuring 100% record parity
user_stories.so_that: we can confidently switch production traffic to MongoDB without data errors

acceptance_criteria.then: every customer record matches PostgreSQL source data exactly

user_stories.title: Configure MongoDB indexes to optimize read performance under 50ms (p95)
user_stories.i_want: to design and set up indexes in MongoDB collections
user_stories.so_that: read operations perform efficiently and meet performance SLAs

user_stories.title: Implement feature flag-driven rollout strategy for gradual migration activation
user_stories.i_want: to enable MongoDB usage progressively using feature flags
user_stories.so_that: we can ensure zero downtime and controlled risk during migration

acceptance_criteria.given: API endpoints connected to data layer
acceptance_criteria.when: feature flag is toggled for MongoDB reads/writes
acceptance_criteria.then: traffic is routed accordingly without service interruption

user_stories.title: Develop rollback mechanism to switch back to PostgreSQL within one hour
user_stories.i_want: to automate rollback procedures to revert data operations to PostgreSQL if issues occur
user_stories.so_that: we can recover from failure rapidly and maintain service continuity

acceptance_criteria.then: system routes writes and reads back to PostgreSQL within one hour and maintains consistency
